goal: Decouple secondary indexes from node internals to avoid lock contention and enable out-of-process indexing
Fix startup and reindexing race conditions that cause redundant block rewinds and query stale data
agreement: Broad concept approval across multiple reviewers (fjahr, mzumsande, josibake, aureleoules)
Approach approval noting the change looks good despite its daunting length (sedited)
Answered objection to defer handling swallowed ReverseBlock return values to a follow-up (furszy)
Open question on why block.height - 1 is used when copying height index to hash index (furszy)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it eliminates lock contention by no longer holding cs_main during index sync and notifications
Fixes race conditions during startup and reindexing that trigger redundant block rewinds
